nodes.description: mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf; token balances, written by transferFrom and batchSend
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; spending approvals read/written in transferFrom and approve
address private owner; privileged address used for access control checks
uint public totalSupply; total token supply set in constructor
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter read in condition
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist flags read in ensure
uint256 private _minSale; minimum sale amount checked in condition
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum sale amount checked in condition
uint256 private _saleNum; max sales per address checked in condition
address tradeAddress; whitelisted trading address set by setTradeAddress and read in ensure
address constant UNI = 0x7a25...488D; router constant used as whitelist in ensure and constructor allowance
uint constant public decimals = 18; used in supply/init scaling
string public name; set in constructor
string public symbol; set in constructor
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist gate, computes pair address and calls condition
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; allowance check plus unchecked balance updates
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces sale count/min/max limits
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only delegatecall to arbitrary address
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only sale parameter initialization
batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only mass transfer with unchecked arithmetic
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only setter of tradeAddress
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; deterministic Uniswap pair address computation
constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable; mints supply to msg.sender and sets owner
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used as authorization subject and token holder
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary external code in this contract's storage context
